Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF), pilot-scope.xlsx (XLSX)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align on timing before year-end.

Recap (from today's call)
- Primary objective: reduce inference cost for batch scoring while preserving latency for interactive dashboards.
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + GCP; 10ms p50 requirement for dashboard queries; ~15M tokens/day estimated.
- Success metric: 25–35% reduction in per-token cost without >5ms p50 regression.

Next steps I proposed
1) Short tech walk (30 min) with Ben to go over network/topology and runtime tuning (Ben in CC).
2) Draft pilot scope (attached) we can run against a small histogram of traffic for 4 weeks.
3) Confirm approval path and expected budget window (we heard "end of quarter" — want to verify).

Asks for you
- Can you confirm who signs off on pilots (budget owner + operational approver)?
- Is there a firm budget window before EOY or is this shifting into Jan?

I attached the notes from today's call and a one-page pilot scope. If it helps, I can propose two slots for the tech walkthrough: Tue 12/28 10:00am PT or Thu 12/30 2:00pm PT.

Thanks — would love a quick note even if timing has slid.

—
Logan Wright

Thanks Samir — totally understand and helpful context. Quick replies below and a compressed cost estimate attached.

- Approval path: perfect — if Lisa is the approver, an intro to her speeds things up. We can provide a short one-page exec summary tailored to CFO priorities (unit economics, expected ROI, contract length).
- Ballpark TCO: see attached; summary in the doc: ~USD 18k one-time setup + USD 3k–6k/mo depending on pilot throughput and caching profile. We'll mark the estimate as DISCOVERY-ONLY (no SLA commitment) for the pilot.
- Success criteria: we'll propose the same metrics we discussed — 25%+ cost reduction vs your baseline and <5ms p50 latency regression.

Next step — would you like me to:
A) Draft an intro email to Lisa with the one-page CFO summary + attached estimate, or
B) Send a calendar invite for Jan 6–8 for the tech walkthrough with Ben and Lisa (if available)?

If you're pushing to Jan, we can also lock in a preliminary pilot calendar now and keep it flexible. Which do you prefer?

Appreciate the quick clarity — will stand by to draft the intro if useful.
